scenes.text: Did you know there is a fifty-mile strip of land in America where you could technically commit a crime and never face trial?
Because of a bizarre constitutional loophole, this section of the park falls within Idaho, but the federal court district belongs to Wyoming.
But absolutely nobody lives in this Idaho sliver of the park, making it literally impossible to form a legal jury.
Would you ever dare to camp in this lawless zone, or should this loophole be closed immediately?
